data.title: Tailwind CSS
data.tagline: A utility-first CSS framework that styles elements through small class names
data.learningOutcome: You can read a few Tailwind classes and identify which change padding, corners, and borders.
data.description: Classes such as `p-6`, `rounded-xl`, and `border` give a card padding, rounded corners, and a border. Tailwind generates CSS rules; the same CSS layout rules still explain why something overlaps or crowds.

learning.assumes: You have seen cards with spacing and borders.
learning.outcome: You can read a few Tailwind classes and identify which change padding, corners, and borders.

explanation.title: Map directly to CSS properties
explanation.text: Each utility class acts as a micro-instruction controlling a single property. For example, p-4 applies 1rem of padding, and text-lg sets a larger font size.

explanation.title: Responsive prefixes control breakpoints
explanation.text: By adding prefixes like md:, lg:, or sm:, you specify at which screen sizes the styles apply, doing responsive design directly in HTML.

explanation.title: State variants handle interactions
explanation.text: Using variants like hover:, focus:, or dark: allows elements to change appearance on interaction or theme change without writing complex selectors.

data.boundary: When a class list is long, group it by spacing, text, borders, and layout. Repeated combinations usually belong in a component.

lessonPractice.title: After adding longer copy to a card, the text feels cramped against its edges. Which Tailwind utility should you change first?

options.label: A p-* utility that controls padding
options.feedback: Correct. Padding controls the space between content and the card edge, and p-* utilities change that padding.

options.label: An m-* utility that controls outer margin
options.feedback: Outer margin changes the card’s distance from neighbors, not the space between its content and edge.

options.label: A rounded-* utility that controls corner radius
options.feedback: rounded-* changes the corner shape, not the distance between content and the edge.

data.agentPrompt: Adjust only this card's Tailwind classes so the content has enough padding while keeping the existing radius and border. Do not change other components. Check both desktop and mobile afterward, then tell me which classes you added or removed.
